$comment: Ledger consumed by scripts/check-deprecations.mjs (new; added in P0).
The gate fails when: (a) a symbol is read outside allowedReadSites, or
(b) a symbol has passed removeInRelease and still exists in the tree.
This is the same known-exception-ledger pattern the repo's other five
gates already use. It exists because a two-release migration that nobody
chases becomes a permanent one, and then the schema has two of everything.
Releases are named after the phase that introduces the deprecation, so
'P3' means 'the release that closes phase 3'. removeInRelease is always
currentRelease is what makes the ledger enforceable: an entry binds only
once the phase that deprecates it has landed. Bump it as each phase closes.
Without it the gate would fail at P0 on symbols that are still correct,
which is how a gate gets switched off.

deprecations.reason: Free-text with zero consumers in either client. Replaced by Profile.addressGender, which Arabic grammar actually requires for second-person agreement. Master spec §19.3.
A boolean cannot express PENDING, REJECTED or SUSPENDED, and the employer-verification gate (§10.4) needs all four. Dual-written during P6.
Superseded by JobRequirement(kind=SKILL) for matching. The schema comment already says it 'stays only for the long tail'; keep it until the long tail is measured at zero.
deprecations.preRemovalCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM "Job" WHERE cardinality("skillsRequired") > 0 AND "createdAt" > now() - interval '90 days'; must be 0

deprecations.reason: Untyped Json with no renderer. Replaced by typed ScreeningQuestion rows. Existing rows may contain data, so it is migrated, not dropped.

Two saved-search systems is exactly the drift the repo's gates exist to prevent. Folded into SavedSearch(kind=JOB, alertEnabled=true). Free-text `industry` values that do not match a PS_INDUSTRIES key are preserved verbatim in queryJson.industryFreeText so no member silently loses an alert.

No writer, no reader, no rows — and permanently unbuildable under Rule 1 (§4.2), because an application boost is money buying rank. Removed outright rather than deprecated.

The browser print dialog was the PDF exporter and has no mobile equivalent, which is why mobile has no CV export at all (HANDOFF gap #6). Replaced by a server-rendered GET /cv/:handle.pdf so there is ONE renderer and one RTL-shaping implementation.

permanentlyBanned.$comment: Symbols that must never return. check-naming.mjs enforces these as banned tokens; each carries the reason so a future reader does not 'fix' the apparent gap.
permanentlyBanned.APPLICATION_BOOST: Money buying rank. Rule 1, master spec §4.2.
permanentlyBanned.BOOST_APPLICATION: Withdrawn reward (HANDOFF gap #1). Debited points, granted nothing. Unbuildable under Rule 1.
permanentlyBanned.FEATURED_PROFILE: Withdrawn reward (HANDOFF gap #1). Unbuildable under Rule 1.
permanentlyBanned.certification: Abstract noun that invites a fourth synonym for Standing. The concrete model `Certificate` is allowed; the abstract noun is not. OCCUPATIONS.md §0 as amended by master spec §4.1.
permanentlyBanned.sponsored: As a code identifier. The model is Promotion; the DTO flag is `promoted`.
permanentlyBanned.community: `network` already means the connections tab. Use Group.

notDeprecated.$comment: Listed because a future audit will propose each of these, and the reasoning should not have to be rediscovered. Master spec §19.6.
notDeprecated.RefreshToken / EmailVerificationToken /: Token or join tables, correctly server-side. Zero client references is the expected state.
notDeprecated.react-native-reanimated / react-native-w: Zero imports, all declared peers of expo-router or @react-navigation/bottom-tabs. Removing them breaks the build.
notDeprecated.OccupationClaim / WorkProof / Standing /: The nine engineless models. Phases 3, 5 and 6 build every one. This plan IS the plan HANDOFF.md said they needed.
notDeprecated.ChatRoom.isGroup / ChatRoom.title: No UI today; full UI in P4.
notDeprecated.UserRating: Full backend, no UI. P6 finally decides the anti-gaming rules (§16.5) that were blocking it.
notDeprecated.KaramaLedger / karamaBalance / decay cro: Reframed as an activity ledger, not a currency. §19.2 explains why deleting it would be the tidy move and the wrong one.
notDeprecated.KaramaReason.REDEEM_BOOST_APPLICATION /: Enum members retained so historical ledger rows still read. Permanently unimplementable.
